title: S3R DVT Suite plugin
description: Describes one collection or analysis plugin. The plugin registry (suite_sdk/registry.py) validates every plugin file against this schema.

id.description: snake_case plugin id; a collection plugin and its analysis plugin share the same id.

paired_with.description: Plugin id of the matching analysis (for collection) or collection (for analysis) plugin.

supported_products.description: Product ids from config/AE_Product_Profiles.json, or "*" for all. Default: all.

supported_firmware.description: Firmware versions, or "*" for all. Default: all.

test.description: One selectable entry in the Collection or Analysis GUI.

key.description: Unique per kind; used in saved GUI settings.

entry.description: Script path relative to this plugin file.

listed.description: false keeps the test out of the GUI lists (default true).

instructions.description: Bench setup text shown before the test runs.

modes.description: Mode name -> script path relative to this plugin file.

aliases.description: Legacy keys in old saved settings that now mean this test.
